chapters.name: Ratio, Proportion & Exponents
chapters.summary: Comparing quantities, scaling, and the laws that make powers easy to handle.
topics: Laws of exponents, zero, negative and fractional powers
chapters.tip: Write every ratio problem as a=kx first; it removes most guesswork.

chapters.name: Basic Inequalities
chapters.summary: Ordering numbers and expressions, the first tool for bounding in olympiad problems.
topics: Number line and properties of inequalities
chapters.tip: When stuck, try moving everything to one side and factoring.

chapters.name: Operations on Algebraic Expressions
chapters.summary: Fast, error-free handling of expressions using standard identities.
chapters.tip: Memorise the identities by writing each one from scratch twice.

chapters.name: Factorization
chapters.summary: Breaking expressions into factors, the most reused skill in algebra and number theory.
topics: Difference of squares, sum and difference of cubes
chapters.tip: Always check for a factor of (x-1), (x+1) before anything fancy.

chapters.name: Polynomials
chapters.summary: Degree, roots and division of polynomials.
chapters.tip: Plug in x=1 and x=-1; the sums often give the answer directly.

chapters.name: Linear Equation in One Variable
chapters.summary: Setting up and solving single-variable equations, including word problems.
topics: Age, work, speed and mixture problems
chapters.tip: Name the unknown for what you are asked, then translate sentence by sentence.

chapters.name: Multivariable Equations
chapters.summary: Systems of equations and elimination.
chapters.tip: Add and subtract equations before substituting; symmetry hides in sums.

chapters.name: Logarithm
chapters.summary: Logarithms as inverse of exponents, with laws and equations.
chapters.tip: Convert to exponent form whenever a log equation looks stuck.

chapters.name: Quadratic Equation
chapters.summary: Solving quadratics and reasoning about their roots.
chapters.tip: Use sum and product of roots before computing the roots themselves.

chapters.name: Sequences and Series
chapters.summary: Patterns in numbers and formulas for their sums.
chapters.tip: For any sum, try writing each term as a difference of two terms.

chapters.name: Divisibility
chapters.summary: Rules and tests that decide when one number divides another.
chapters.tip: Reduce the number mod the divisor and work with the small remainder.

chapters.name: Primes, Composite & Perfect Squares
chapters.summary: Structure of integers through prime factorization.
topics: Perfect squares and their divisor structure
chapters.tip: A number is a perfect square exactly when every prime exponent is even.

chapters.name: Division & Euclidean Algorithm
chapters.summary: Division with remainder and the algorithm that finds the gcd.
chapters.tip: Write n=qd+r and reason about r; it is the doorway to congruences.

chapters.name: G.C.D. & L.C.M.
chapters.summary: Greatest common divisor, least common multiple and how they relate.
topics: gcd and lcm via prime factors
Word problems on gcd and lcm
chapters.tip: Compare prime exponents; gcd takes the minimum, lcm the maximum.

chapters.name: Number Theoretic Functions
chapters.summary: Functions that count and add divisors.
chapters.tip: Learn the divisor formulas as products over prime powers.

chapters.name: Congruences
chapters.summary: Arithmetic with remainders.
chapters.tip: For huge powers, find the cycle length of the last digit first.

chapters.name: Problem Solving with Number Theory
chapters.summary: Applying everything to olympiad-style questions.
chapters.tip: Try mod 3, 4, 5, 8 on any equation that seems to have no integer solution.

chapters.name: Lines, Angles & Polygons
chapters.summary: Angle facts that drive every geometry proof.
chapters.tip: Mark every known angle on the figure before thinking about a method.

chapters.name: Triangles
chapters.summary: Triangle properties, inequalities and special lines.
chapters.tip: Look for right triangles; Pythagoras hides in many figures.

chapters.name: Congruence of Triangles
chapters.summary: Proving two triangles identical.
chapters.tip: State which three parts match and why before claiming congruence.

chapters.name: Similarity of Triangles
chapters.summary: Triangles with the same shape and the ratios they give.
topics: Ratio of areas of similar triangles
chapters.tip: Find parallel lines or equal angles; they signal similarity.

chapters.name: Quadrilaterals & Properties
chapters.summary: Special quadrilaterals and their diagonals and angles.
chapters.tip: Join the midpoints or draw a diagonal to split into triangles.

chapters.name: Circles & Properties
chapters.summary: Chords, arcs and angles in a circle.
chapters.tip: Equal angles on the same chord often means the points are concyclic.

chapters.name: Circles & Tangents
chapters.summary: Tangents, power of a point and related transformations.
chapters.tip: A tangent is perpendicular to the radius; draw the radius first.

chapters.name: Mensuration (Area)
chapters.summary: Areas of plane figures.
chapters.tip: Split a shaded region into pieces whose areas you know.

chapters.name: Mensuration (Surface Areas & Volumes)
chapters.summary: Solids and their surface area and volume.
chapters.tip: Keep units consistent; convert before you substitute.

chapters.name: Trigonometry (Applications)
chapters.summary: Trigonometric ratios applied to heights and distances.
chapters.tip: Draw a clean right triangle and label the angle of elevation.

chapters.name: Coordinate Geometry (Intro)
chapters.summary: Geometry on the coordinate plane.
topics: Slope and equation of a line
chapters.tip: Place the figure so that key points sit on the axes.

chapters.name: Combinatorics
chapters.summary: Counting methods from basic principles to inclusion-exclusion and pigeonhole.
topics: Colouring, tiling and the box principle
chapters.tip: Ask first whether order matters, then whether repeats are allowed.

chapters.name: Binomial Theorem
chapters.summary: Expansion of powers of a binomial.
chapters.tip: Substitute x=1 and x=-1 to get sums of coefficients quickly.
